_comment: TEMPLATE for `rate_check.py --manual-quotes` (GOL-2641) — the no-network refresh path. Copy this file, then for EACH cell read the least-cost allowlisted ground quote (UPS Ground `03` / UPS Ground Saver `93` / USPS Ground Advantage `GroundAdvantage`, residential) for that zone's reference corner at that box's dimensions and MEDIAN packed weight (GOL-2923 — printed by probe_states.py as the representative billable weight), and record the RAW CARRIER QUOTE plus which service you read it off. Do NOT put finished rates here: rate_check applies ceil (carrier-only — the flat $5 S&H is added once per order by the app, NOT per cell), the monotonicity guard and the $1 drift gate itself. Zone corners and box geometry are printed by `python3 scripts/rate_check/probe_states.py`. Set `_quoted_on` to the date you actually read the quotes — it becomes the `_rates_verified_on` stamp the freshness guard trusts. This template is deliberately NOT applyable as-is (zero quotes, placeholder date) so it can never be used to stamp the table fresh without real numbers.
